cohort: The study participants were 213 pregnant women who underwent either natural childbirth or painless delivery between 2020 and 2022.
finding: There were no significant differences in neonatal Apgar scores or dysrhythmia between infants born via painless delivery and those born via natural childbirth.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in Apgar scores or neonatal dysrhythmia between painless delivery and natural childbirth.
